paper_title: The Safety Reminder A Soft Prompt to Reactivate Delayed Safety   Awareness in Vision-Language Models
caption: The proportion of harmful responses in which the model showed a rejection tendency.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the Harmful with Refusal Ratio for different models and datasets. The y-axis, labeled "Harmful with Refusal Ratio", is scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.5 in increments of 0.1. The x-axis is scaled linearly from 128 to 1024, with tick labels at intervals of 256, representing an unspecified unit. The plot features four lines: Llama-1.5-7B on FigStep (blue, circle markers, solid line), Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep (orange, square markers, solid line), Llama-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench (green, triangle markers, solid line), and Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench (red, diamond markers, solid line). The blue line starts at approximately 0.25 and increases to 0.38; the orange line starts at about 0.15 and increases to 0.42; the green line starts at approximately 0.05 and increases to 0.37; and the red line starts at around 0.25 and increases to 0.52.
